records.source_japanese: 戦闘を仕掛ける相手がいません
records.english: There are no targets to attack.
records.speaker: System
records.context: Declare War Mode has no eligible on-screen attack target. The lower sailing screen shows this two-line notice.
records.source_meaning: There is no opponent available to attack.
records.localization_note: Use target rather than opponent to cover eligible fleets or cities without implying the player is globally at peace. Preserve the complete message; do not shorten to the original allocation.
records.source_layout_text: 戦闘を仕掛ける　相手がいません
